summary: Biggs declared in 2017 that he "unequivocally stands with Israel," and in 2024 co-signed a letter calling a Gaza ceasefire a way to "allow Hamas to regroup." He called Hamas "pro-genocide" and "anti-Israel" in a May 2024 statement. In July 2026 he told Stew Peters "Keep preaching" after Peters invoked a "final solution" involving deportation of American Jews, then won the Arizona gubernatorial nomination. His Nay on H.R. 6090 rests on stated constitutional objections, not a pro-Palestine rationale.
